postal_system.code_format: Legacy area BBNNNNN or updated building-linked BBNNNNN-AAAAA; BB is integral and the suffix is five alphanumeric characters
postal_system.assignment_rule: The current BPS lookup can validate one time-bound legacy result. The Government of Barbados 13 December 2024 launch defines an updated code by dropping the parish identifier from the six-character BBID and appending its remaining five characters to the old postcode. Only a release-pinned operator result or permitted Lands and Surveys feature can establish an assignment; syntax, a model, an address string or this fixture cannot.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No rights-cleared nationwide postcode polygon release is bundled. A permitted BBID feature may establish one observed building footprint linked to BuildingID, ShortPosta and LongPostal; locality, parish, paid Digimap, OSM, buffers, Voronoi cells and model surfaces are not official postcode polygons.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, attention, organization, building or premises name, unit, house number, street, district or neighbourhood, locality, parish, post office, P.O. Box, BBID, legacy postcode and updated postcode separately. Formatting examples are not reusable address rows.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store postal object type independently as legacy_area, updated_building_linked_code, building_footprint, locality_assignment, route, post_office, po_box, organization, point, polygon, multipolygon, unknown or derived_review_surface.
postal_system.building_rule: An exact building display requires a permitted release-pinned feature relation among BuildingID, ShortPosta, LongPostal and its building footprint, or another rights-cleared stable explicit relation. Legacy postcode, updated-code syntax, locality, parish, coordinate, address string, parcel, containment, proximity or model output is insufficient.
postal_system.administrative_rule: Preserve parish and locality identity, source edition and validity independently from BPS postcode assignments, BBID and LongPostal. Reference locality or parish geometry cannot supply a missing suffix, establish delivery or replace a building relation.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Realtime BPS or BBID queries validate single observations only with purpose, minimized query, terms, rate policy, service and layer version, observed_at, selected fields and request-response digests. Timeout or empty response is unknown. Deterministic and learned outputs may normalize, index, compress with error bounds, flag drift and prioritize review; they never invent a BBID, suffix, assignment, boundary, address, premises, person or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Versioned crosswalks may relate permitted postal observations, administrative context, explicit building relations and derived review surfaces to AGID cells without relabelling AGID as canonical Barbados postal or BBID geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Public lookup or ArcGIS Query access is not bulk automation, caching or redistribution permission. BPS pages, UPU publication, BGIS launch, BBID features, reference-only locality, all-rights-reserved parish, paid Digimap and ODbL content retain separate rights and provenance partitions.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: The pack is ISO BB scope and separates postal, BBID, building, political-administrative, cadastral, civic-address, community and AGID representations. It does not infer maritime coverage or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Building-unique LongPostal, BBID, precise footprint, address, premises, unit, resident, owner, occupant and lookup logs can expose household or security context. Apply purpose limitation, query and log minimisation, retention, access control and publication review.
postal_system.temporal_rule: The November 2014 UPU sheet predates the 13 December 2024 BBID update. BPS lookup results, BBID features, ShortPosta and LongPostal links, services, layers, administrative context, buildings, derived surfaces and AGID crosswalks are time-dependent; store valid_from, valid_to, observed_at, retrieved_at, version, digest and supersession.
postal_system.hugging_face_rule: Publish only rights-cleared versioned Parquet, GeoParquet or PMTiles partitions with exact attribution, jurisdiction, schema, CRS, provenance and digests. Building-unique codes, precise household features, restricted records and credentials remain private, gated or external. Production readers pin a Hub commit and verify shard digests.
